messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'cedarbridge-eu-central' p99 latency > SLO (1.5s). Current p95=0.9s p99=3.1s, error rate steady. Trigger: threshold breach (p99 > 1.5s for 3m). Paging oncall.
oncall-ingest: ack. I'm up, pulling logs and metrics now.
sre-julia: I see a spike starting ~3m ago. KV cache miss rate jumped for that pool. Possible noisy tenant causing long KV reads. Attaching quick graph.
eng-runtime-lee: I can try to enable aggressive prefix caching for cedarbridge routing to reduce recompute. Also checking node-level CPU/GPU saturation.
eng-oncall-ken: cpu% on the serving nodes in pool eu-central-dedicated are 78-92%. Network egress looks normal. No node OOMs.
solutions-ben: cc @account-exec-maya and @customer-ops-cedarbridge — customer is seeing increased latency on production endpoints, reporting timeouts from UI.
customer-ops-cedarbridge: we're getting about 8 customer complaints in the last 10m, mostly slow responses and occasional 504s. They asked if there's a mitigation.
eng-runtime-lee: Plan: 1) isolate noisy tenants by applying tenant QoS (rate-limit/evict if needed), 2) bring up warm-spare capacity in eu-west for overflow, 3) apply cache patch to reduce KV thrash. Starting step 1 now.
sre-julia: Eviction playbook: run orchestrator eviction command for target tenant. Recommend targeted eviction vs pool-wide reboot.
eng-oncall-ken: Which tenant looks noisy? I see a tenant with burst qps ~6x normal: cedarbridge-analytics-tenant (id: cb-analytics-7).
eng-runtime-lee: Confirmed. cb-analytics-7 has sustained long context generations hurting KV reuse. I'll run an eviction with a 5m drain and route traffic to fallback model for that tenant.
eng-runtime-lee: ```
# evict tenant (dry run)
rb orchestrator evict-tenant --tenant cb-analytics-7 --pool eu-central-dedicated --reason "p99 latency spike" --drain 300
# to actually evict:
rb orchestrator evict-tenant --tenant cb-analytics-7 --pool eu-central-dedicated --force --drain 300
```
oncall-ingest: running dry run now.
platform-ops-bot: Task started: eviction-dryrun-3187654321-cb-analytics-7. ETA 90s.
platform-ops-bot: Dry run complete. Predicted impact: 6% latency improvement for pool.
eng-runtime-lee: Good. Proceeding with force eviction in 30s.
eng-oncall-ken: eviction in progress... logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:14:22Z evict start tenant=cb-analytics-7 host=node-12
2026-03-15T09:15:01Z drain connections -> routed to fallback model (gpt-small-quant)
2026-03-15T09:16:10Z tenant eviction complete
```
sre-julia: p99 dropped from 3.1s -> 1.8s within 2m after eviction. Still above SLO but trending down.
eng-runtime-lee: I'm turning on aggressive prefix caching for cedarbridge (10m TTL) and enabling KV hot-key pinning.
eng-runtime-lee: ```
# debug config
rb config set pool:cedarbridge-eu prefix_cache_ttl=600
rb config set pool:cedarbridge-eu kv_pin=true
```
platform-ops-bot: Config apply queued to 3 nodes, rollout 30s.
eng-oncall-ken: Config rolled out. p99 now 1.4s, p95 0.85s. Back under SLO for p99.
customer-ops-cedarbridge: Seeing responsiveness restored on UI, thank you. We'll keep monitoring.
account-exec-maya: Noting customer impact and timeline. Preparing a short incident update for CedarBridge support: summary + action taken + ETA for postmortem.
solutions-ben: For continuity, let's route new heavy analytics jobs to the CedarBridge dedicated analytics pool we provisioned last quarter. Can we add a temporary routing rule?
eng-runtime-lee: Yes — adding a routing rule to send requests with header X-CB-ANALYTICS to analytics-pool-eu. Applying.
eng-runtime-lee: ```
rb routing add --match 'header:X-CB-ANALYTICS' --to analytics-pool-eu --priority 100
```
platform-ops-bot: Routing rule applied across control plane.
sre-julia: Monitoring for 30m. If stable, we mark mitigated and hand off to daytime oncall for postmortem and follow-up.
oncall-ingest: I'll stay for the 30m monitoring window and then handoff to @eng-oncall-ken for daytime shift.
account-exec-maya: I'll sync with CedarBridge CSM and give a 1-hour interim update. We'll schedule a postmortem with technical owners within 48h.
customer-ops-cedarbridge: Appreciate the rapid response. Can you add us to the postmortem invite — we'll want logs for cb-analytics-7 activity.
eng-runtime-lee: Will collect KV traces and a timeline. Also will include eviction dry-run outputs and cache patches.
sre-julia: Severity: Sev3 (customer-impact SLO breach), mitigated -> monitoring. Action items: 1) postmortem, 2) permanent tenant isolation or route-to-analytics-pool, 3) review autoscaling thresholds for dedicated pools, 4) add guardrail for long-running contexts per tenant.
eng-oncall-ken: Handing off at 09:52 UTC to daytime oncall. Leaving runbook notes in incident doc.
incidents-bot: Incident updated to status=mitigated. Tags: customer:cedarbridge, pool:eu-central-dedicated, cause: noisy-tenant, mitigation:eviction+cache
account-exec-maya: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks team.
customer-ops-cedarbridge: Thanks all, will await postmortem.
eng-runtime-lee: Quick note for postmortem: attach model-level latency histograms and KV miss heatmap for the hour around the spike.
sre-julia: Logging incident timeline to ops/incidents/3187654321 for PM review.
